主要内容: On May 11, 2016, Core Laboratories N.V. entered into an Underwriting Agreement with Credit Suisse Securities (USA) LLC. The Company granted the Underwriter a 30-day option to purchase up to 221,250 additional shares of its common stock at the Purchase Price. The Company intends to use the estimated net proceeds from the Firm Share Offering of approximately $171.4 million to repay a portion of the outstanding borrowings under the Company’s revolving credit facility. The Firm Share Offering closed on May 17, 2016.
